content: Saulo ɛ́ lótsulá dɩ́nká Stefano mɔsʋ. Saulo Ɔpasua Ámʋsʋ Dɩnká Tsú ɛkɛ ámʋsʋ á, bɛdɩnká ɔpasua ámʋ́ʋ́ ɩbʋ Yerusalem amʋsʋ, wá amʋ́ mɔ bɩ. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔpasua ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bɛdasáɩ́n wá Yudea pʋ́ Samaria ɔmátɔ́, sí sumbí ayɔpʋ́ ámʋ nkʋlɛ pɛ́ wá ɩnʋ.
Támɛ Bulu asúmpʋ́ akʋ bosu Stefano, bɩn mʋ.
Saulo mʋ́ léfi ɔpasua ámʋ bwie asɩ. Oletsiá kí ahá wóyítɔ́, bɩ́tɩ́a ahógyipʋ atsɩ mʋ́a ayin fɛ́ɛ́ yɔ́wa obu.
Filipo Bulu Asʋ́n Ɔkanda Samaria Wúlutɔ
Ahógyipʋ amʋ bɛda Bulu asʋn wankláán ámʋ ɔkan ɔtɩ́nɛgyíɔtɩ́nɛ́ ánɩ́ bɛdasáɩ́n yɔ́.
Mʋ́ sʋ Filipo lɔ́yɔ Samaria wúlu yilé kʋtɔ yɛ́bláa amʋ́ Kristo, (ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu ladá mʋ ofúli amʋ) ɩwɩ asʋn wankláán ámʋ.
Afíapʋ amʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bonu mʋ asʋn blɩ́hɛ́, bowun osúna ánɩ́ ɔlɔbwɛ ɛ́. Mʋ́ sʋ bɔhɔ mʋ asʋ́n ámʋ.
Ɔŋɛ laláhɛ lɔ́sʋrá okitikíti dálɩ ahá tsɔtsɔɔtsɔtɔ. Ahá ánɩ́ amʋ́ ɩfʋ́n lawú pʋ́ tsukʋlɛ asínpʋ tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ ɛ́ benya ɩlɔtsá.
Mʋ́ sʋ ansɩ́ lɛhɩɛ gyi Samariafɔ ámʋ.

Alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ á, ɔfápʋ́ kpɔnkpɔntɩ ɔkʋá bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ Simon bʋ wúlu amʋtɔ. Brɛ́á Filipo mɔ́kʋ́ba ɩnʋ á, ɔtɔbwɛ́ túmila súná mʋ pɩ amʋ, ɩtɔwá amʋ́ ifú. Ɔtɔpʋ́ ɩbɩ sí kántɔ́ blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, otúmípʋ kpɔnkpɔntɩ mʋgyi.
Nyebí ahandɛ fɛ́ɛ́ bʋtobú mʋ, blɩ́ bɛɛ, “Oyin ánfɩ dɛ́ Bulu túmi kpɔnkpɔntɩ ámʋ.”
Ɩ́nɩá ɔdɛpʋ mʋ asuma bwɛ́ ofúla suná amʋ́, ɩlawá ɔpá sʋ á, amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ bɔhɔ mʋ gyi.
Támɛ brɛ́á Filipo lɛ́ba bɛda Bulu iwíegyí pʋ́ Yesu Kristo ɩwɩ asʋn wankláán ámʋ ɔkan a, atsɩ mʋ́a ayin bɔhɔ mʋ asʋ́n ámʋsʋ gyi, ɔlɔbɔ amʋ́ asú.
Simon onutó ɛ́ lóhogyi, ɔlɛha Filipo lɔ́bɔ mʋ asú. Mʋ asúbɔ ɔma a, ɔlɔpʋ ɩwɩ mantáa Filipo. Brɛ́á olowun alɩá Filipo dɛ́ ofúla mʋ́a osúna bwɛ á, ɔnɔ́ lobwie mʋ.
Sumbí ayɔpʋ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋbʋ Yerusalem amʋ bonu ánɩ́ Samariafɔ bahɔ Bulu asʋ́n ámʋ. Mʋ́ sʋ bɔwa Petro mʋa Yohane amʋ́ wá.
Brɛ́á boyówie ɩnʋ á, bɔbɔ mpáɩ há Samariafɔ ahógyipʋ amʋ bɛɛ, bʋnyáa Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́.
Tsúfɛ́ asú kɛkɛ babɔ́ amʋ́ anɩ Wíe Yesu dátɔ́, támɛ amʋ́tɔ́ ɔkʋkʋ mɔ́kʋ́nyá Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ amʋ.
Ɩnʋ Petro mʋa Yohane bɔpʋ ɩbɩ dɩ́nká amʋ́ nwunsʋ, Bulu lɛ́ha amʋ́ Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ amʋ.
Simon lówun ánɩ́ ɩbɩ kɛkɛ sumbí ayɔpʋ́ amʋ bapʋ́ dɩ́nká ahógyipʋ amʋ nwunsʋ, Bulu lahá amʋ́ Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛlɛ kɔ́ba há Petro mʋa Yohane,
ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩha mɩ́ túmi ánfɩ kʋ, mɛ́nɩ nɩ́ mɩ́ ɛ́ nɔpʋ́ ɩbɩ dɩ́nká ɔkʋ nwunsʋ á, Bulu ɔbɛ́ha mʋ Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́.”
Támɛ Petro lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Fʋ́a fʋ́ kɔ́ba ámʋ nyɔ fɛ́ɛ́ mlɩhɩ. Tsúfɛ́ fʋkɩ fɛɛ, fɛ́talɩ́ pʋ́ kɔ́ba hɔ Bulu itokiehɛ́ ánfɩ.
Fʋma ogyíkpá ntɛ́ɛ ɔlɩɩ́kpá anɩ gyumagyihɛ anfɩtɔ, tsúfɛ́ fʋ́ klʋntɔ mɛtɩn Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́.
Damli klʋntɔ tsu fʋ́ lakpan ánfɩtɔ, afʋkʋlɩ anɩ Wíe Bulu. Fíalɩ obési agywɩɩn laláhɛ anfɩ́ fabwɛ́ ánfɩ kíé fʋ́.
Tsúfɛ́ nawun ánɩ́ fʋhɩ́ɛ́ fʋ́bʋ ɔnsɩpɛ, lakpan lagyi fʋsʋ.”
Simon lɛ́bláa Petro mʋa Yohane ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nobwíí ɩpa, mlɩkokoli mlɩ Wíe Bulu ha mɩ, mɛ́nɩ ɔmɛ́ɛha asʋ́n ánfɩ fablɩ́ ánfɩtɔ kʋkʋ mɛ́ɛba mɩsʋ.”
Brɛ́á Petro mʋa Yohane begyi adánsɩɛ, dá Yesu ɩwɩ asʋ́n ámʋ ɔkan tá á, beyinkí yɔ́ Yerusalem. Brɛ́á bʋna bɔyɔ́ á, bɛda asʋn wankláán ámʋ ɔkan Samaria nkuda tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ asɩ.
Etiopia Owíe Sikasʋ Ɔkɩ́pʋ Klʋntɔdamlí
Alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ á, Bulu-ɔbɔpʋ lɛ́bláa Filipo ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Kʋsʋ pʋ ɔsaasɩ́ dimbísʋ́ ɔkpa ámʋ́ʋ́ ɩda tsu Yerusalem ɩyɔ́ Gasa amʋ.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ Filipo lɔ́kʋsʋ́ pʋ́ ɔkpa. Brɛ́á ɔyɔ́ á, ɔlɔtʋ Etiopia ɔmá ɔhandɛ ɔkʋá baflo mʋ. Ɔhandɛ amʋ gyí Etiopia owíe tsɩhɛ́ Kandake sikasʋ ɔkɩ́pʋ. Oyin ánfɩ layɔ́ Yerusalem yósum Bulu,
yínkí ɔyɔ́ wóyí, otsie mʋ kekétɔ́, mpɔnkɔ bʋdɛ mʋ bɩtɩ́. Ɔdɛ Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ Yesaia ɔwʋlʋ́ ámʋ kláa.
Mʋ́ʋ́ Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ lɛ́bláa Filipo ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Kpʋkpɛ manta keké ánfɩ.”
Filipo lɛ́srɩ́ tʋ́ keké ámʋ wun ánɩ́ Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ Yesaia ɔwʋlʋ́ ámʋ oyin ámʋ dɛ́ kláa. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔhandɛ, fʋdɛ asʋ́n ámʋ́ʋ́ fʋdɛkláa amʋ asɩ nu?”
Ɔhandɛ amʋ lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nkálɩ ɩbɔ́bwɛ nónu mʋ́ asɩ nɩ́ ɔkʋ mɛ́lɛ mʋ́ asɩ súná mɩ́?” Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛbláa Filipo ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Dʋ tsia mɩ́ wá ayɔ.”
Bulu asʋ́n ánɩ́ ɔdɛkláa ɔwʋlʋ́ ámʋtɔ gyí:

content.text: “Ɔlɔbwɛ díín fɛ́ kufa ánɩ́ bapʋ́ bɛya ɔmɔkpá. Ɔmobwií mʋ nnonyɔ.
Ɔlɔbwɛ díín fɛ́ alɩá kufa tɔbwɛ́
nɩ́ bʋdɛ mʋ ɩwɩ imi dɩnkɩ́.
Bɔkpɔɩ́ mʋ, bʋmegyi mʋ asʋ́n ɔnɔkwalɩsʋ.
tsúfɛ́ bɛka mʋ nkpa tin ɔsʋlʋ́ʋ anfɩsʋ.”

content: Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔmá ɔhandɛ amʋ lɛ́fɩtɛ́ Filipo ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ma ɩwɩ asʋ́n Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ anfɩ dɛ́blɩ́, mʋ onutó ntɛ́ɛ ɔha bambá?”
Ɩnʋ Filipo lɛ́lɩɩ́ Yesaia asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ anfɩsʋ bláa mʋ Yesu ɩwɩ asʋn wankláán ámʋ.
Bɔpʋ bɔyɔ́ á, bɔtʋ ntsu kʋ. Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔmá ɔhandɛ amʋ lɛ́fɩtɛ́ Filipo ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ntsu dá a, ntɔ létin mɩ́ asúbɔ ɔkpa?”
Mʋ́ sʋ ɔmá ɔhandɛ amʋ lɛ́ha mʋ keké ámʋ ɔbɩtɩ́pʋ́ lɛ́lɩɩ́. Mʋa Filipo bɛkplɩ́ wíé ntsu ámʋtɔ, Filipo lɔ́bɔ mʋ asú.
Brɛ́á bɛdalɩ ntsu ámʋtɔ á, anɩ Wíe Ɔŋɛ́ lotsu Filipo nátɩ́. Ɔmá ɔhandɛ amʋ mɛ́trá wun mʋ, támɛ ɔlɔpʋ ansigyí natɩ́ ɔyɔ́ wóyí.
Filipo ɛ́ lɛ́yɛdalɩ Asoto wúlutɔ. Ɔlɛnatɩ́ kí ɩnʋ awúlusʋ dá asʋn wankláán ámʋ ɔkan alɩɩ, oloyówie Kaesarea wúlutɔ.
